# `ContextOwnershipViolation`

`Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Exception\ContextOwnershipViolation`

**Class** — **Package:** [rasuvaeff/understudy](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy/blob/master/src/Exception/ContextOwnershipViolation.php#L14) — **Version:** v0.8.0

**Extends:** `LogicException`

**Implements:** `Throwable`, `Stringable`, [`Exception\UnderstudyError`](/api/classes/Exception/UnderstudyError)

Configuration and verification belong to the context that created a double.

Normal calls may cross Fiber boundaries, but mutating another context would
make lifecycle verification race with work owned elsewhere.

## Methods

### forDouble()

```php
static forDouble(): Exception\ContextOwnershipViolation
```

A double was configured or verified from a context other than the one
that created it — another Fiber, or outside the scope it was built in.
